Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final individual character portrait for Aleria. Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Reference 1 is her mother Esyllt Penrudd, reference 2 her father Cynddelw Llythfor: inherit recognisable family traits and the exact illustration style, but create their distinct young daughter.
Subject: Eirlys Llythfor, a TEN-YEAR-OLD Cenyri girl, with unmistakably childlike facial and body proportions. Warm brown eyes, brown hair in TWO neat plaits hanging over her shoulders, a few playful loose wisps, fine freckles like her mother. A broad mischievous joyous grin with one clearly visible gap from a missing FRONT TOOTH. Upper-body portrait showing both hands: she holds a short simple wooden drawing pencil in one hand and a small ragged scrap of drawing paper in the other. A tiny uneven horse doodle on the scrap is fine. Smudges of charcoal on her fingertips. Practical simple muted teal dress over cream linen sleeves, ordinary comfortable city-child clothes. Relaxed lively posture, looking towards the viewer as if proudly showing her drawing. Soft quiet sunlit timber-window background in the family's Gwynthor home, only one person, restrained composition. Normal rounded human ears, no modern objects, no lettering or portrait frame.

Use case: stylized-concept. One square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration. The attached ring is an ART STYLE reference only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured leather and metal, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Never copy the ring shape, eel emblem or house colors. Not photorealistic, not CGI, not a glossy 3D render. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, about 10% clear margin on every side. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; no person, hands, scenery, floor, stand, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. No unrelated objects.
Subject: ONE handsome small hand-bound medieval travel notebook, closed, in a gentle three-quarter view. Supple deep forest-green leather cover, neatly tooled simple interlaced border with no heraldry, warm brown leather spine, cream handmade-paper page edges, modest brass corner pieces and a small practical brass clasp. The object should be attractive, carefully made and useful, an ordinary prosperous reporter's gift rather than a magical or royal artifact. Completely blank unused pages suggested by the page edges. No readable title, lettering, symbols of any house or guild, no quill, no ink bottle, no loose papers. The notebook alone.

Subject: ONE compact medieval travelling writing kit arranged as a single readable inventory set: a simple brown leather sleeve with a flap, one neatly cut pale goose quill resting diagonally across it, and a squat small dark glass ink bottle securely closed with a cork and tied cloth collar. Fine practical ordinary writing tools a newspaper reporter would give someone, well kept but not luxurious or magical.
